b: Apologies to my earliest risers this morning! Even though I was awake well past midnight, I was just too wiped out to get today’s prompt posted (like I was falling asleep standing up area). But once we get through today’s poem, we’ll be three weeks in, so let’s do this!

For today’s prompt, take the phrase “On (blank),” replace the blanks with a new word or phrase, make the new phrase the title of your poem, and then, write your poem. Possible titles might include: “On Top of the Stove,” “On the Way Back Home,” “On and Off Switch,” “On Saturday Morning,” and/or “On the Meaning of Life.”
Remember: These prompts are springboards to creativity. Use them to expand your possibilities, not limit them.

Here’s my attempt at an On Blank Poem:

Some people say everything that’s
happened or that will happen and is
currently happening exists all at once
like text written on a scroll, but we
experience it in our own good time,
and I’m not saying they’re right or
wrong, because can’t we all get
along, but if they are, then I suppose
being late is the same as on time.
